title: How AI Is Changing the Way We Learn
desc: AI 导师怎么根据你的水平调整课程？读一读未来的课堂。

vocab.en: a teacher who teaches one person or a small group
vocab.ex: An AI tutor can change the lesson to fit your level.
vocab.exZh: 一位 AI 导师可以根据你的水平调整课程。

vocab.ex: If you understand a concept quickly, it moves on.
vocab.exZh: 如果你很快理解了一个概念，它就会继续往前。

vocab.en: a set of rules a computer follows to solve a problem
vocab.ex: Behind this tutor is an algorithm that looks for patterns.
vocab.exZh: 这位导师的背后是一种算法。

vocab.ex: The system builds a personalised path through the subject.
vocab.exZh: 这个系统会为你打造一条个性化的学习路径。

vocab.en: advice about how well you did something
vocab.ex: Teachers can spend more time giving feedback.
vocab.exZh: 老师可以花更多时间给出反馈。

vocab.en: to change in order to fit a new situation
vocab.ex: Humans and machines learn to adapt to each other.
vocab.exZh: 人和机器学会彼此适应。

en: For many students, learning a new subject used to mean sitting in a crowded classroom and listening to the same lesson as everyone else.
Today, an AI tutor can watch how you answer questions and change the next lesson to fit your level.
If you understand a concept quickly, it moves on; if you struggle, it slows down and explains it in a different way.
zh: 对许多学生来说，学习一门新科目过去意味着坐在拥挤的教室里，和所有人听同一节课。
如今，一位 AI 导师可以观察你如何回答问题，并调整下一课以适应你的水平。
如果你很快理解了一个概念，它就会继续往前；如果你遇到困难，它会放慢速度，用另一种方式讲解。

en: Behind this tutor is an algorithm that looks for patterns in your mistakes.
It notices, for example, that you often mix up two similar words, and then it gives you more practice with exactly those words.
Over time, the system builds a personalised path through the subject, one that no textbook could offer.
zh: 这位导师的背后是一种算法，它会在你的错误中寻找规律。
比如，它会注意到你常常混淆两个相似的词，然后就针对这些词给你更多练习。
随着时间的推移，这个系统会为你打造一条个性化的学习路径，这是任何教科书都无法提供的。

en: Teachers are not being replaced, but their work is changing.
Instead of repeating the same lesson, they can spend more time giving feedback and helping students who need it most.
The best classrooms of the future may be those where humans and machines learn to adapt to each other.
zh: 老师并没有被取代，但他们的工作正在改变。
他们不再需要重复同一节课，而是可以花更多时间给出反馈，帮助最需要帮助的学生。
未来的好课堂，也许是人和机器学会彼此适应的课堂。

phrases.en: to do something regularly in the past, but not now
phrases.ex: I used to play football when I was young.
When approaching a bend in the road, slow down.
He spent his life looking for the truth.
For example, I like apples and bananas.
phrases.exZh: 例如，我喜欢苹果和香蕉。

phrases.ex: He often mixes up two similar words.
phrases.exZh: 他常常混淆两个相似的词。

phrases.ex: He walked to school instead of taking the car.
phrases.exZh: 他走路去上学，而不是坐车。

phrases.en: to gain the skill to do something
phrases.ex: Children learn to read at school.
phrases.exZh: 孩子们在学校学会阅读。
